`POST /rpc` with a JSON-RPC 2.0 body, one request per call (batches are not accepted).

<Tabs items={['curl', 'JavaScript', 'Python']}>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -s https://test.qrdx.org/rpc \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[]}'
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="JavaScript">
```js
async function rpc(method, ...params) {
  const res = await fetch('https://test.qrdx.org/rpc', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method, params }),
  })
  const body = await res.json()
  if (body.error) throw new Error(`${body.error.code}: ${body.error.message}`)
  return body.result
}

const height = parseInt(await rpc('eth_blockNumber'), 16)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
import httpx

def rpc(method, *params):
    r = httpx.post("https://test.qrdx.org/rpc",
                   json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": list(params)})
    body = r.json()
    if "error" in body:
        raise RuntimeError(body["error"])
    return body["result"]

height = int(rpc("eth_blockNumber"), 16)
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

## Namespaces

| Namespace | For |
| --- | --- |
| `eth_*` | Ethereum-compatible: blocks, balances, calls, logs, filters, raw transactions |
| `qrdx_*` | account ids, address info, intrinsic gas |
| `exchange_*` | tokens, NFTs, pools, spot books, quotes; signing payloads, submission, receipts |
| `perp_*` | perps markets, books, accounts, vault, events |
| `market_*` | one shape for every market: tickers, books, trades, candles |
| `tx_*` | the transaction index |
| `net_*`, `web3_*` | network and client |

The [method reference](/docs/reference/json-rpc) lists all of them.

## Ethereum compatibility

Standard tools (ethers, viem, web3.py) work for reads and classic transactions. Differences:

- `eth_getBalance`, `eth_getTransactionCount` and `eth_getCode` also accept `0xPQ…` addresses, resolved to the account id.
- Only legacy and type-`0x51` raw transactions are accepted; send EIP-1559 fees as a legacy `gasPrice`.
- Native tokens are ERC-20s at their addresses, so `eth_call` to `balanceOf` works.

<RpcPlayground method="eth_getBalance" params={["0xPQF024d7895096D4Cd86fD4bC68e526FbdE8373e83C78F2CaEeE9279249201aCbc", "latest"]} note="Balances are hex wei (1 QRDX = 10¹⁸ wei). A 0xPQ address resolves to its account id." />
